objective: Implement deterministic fail-closed idempotency and duplicate-prevention admission for P20 execution requests, allowing exact replay of an existing request while rejecting conflicting idempotency-key, client-order, fingerprint and operation/order claims, with no retry, reconciliation, network, external-order or Live authority.
scope: Define canonical ORDER_SUBMIT and ORDER_CANCEL idempotency admission contract
Bind idempotency claims to market/order/operation/request fingerprint
Allow exact replay of the same canonical claim without creating a new claim
Reject idempotency-key reuse with conflicting request lineage
Reject duplicate client_order_id under a different idempotency key within a market
Reject duplicate request fingerprint under a different idempotency key within market/operation scope
Reject duplicate operation/order claim under a different idempotency key
out_of_scope: Network calls or external order submission
dependencies: Owner P20 phase authorization GRANTED / CONSUMED
tests: First canonical request produces ADMIT_NEW deterministically
Exact replay produces REPLAY_EXISTING with the same claim
Idempotency-key reuse with conflicting lineage fails closed
Duplicate client_order_id under another key fails closed
Duplicate request fingerprint under another key fails closed
Duplicate operation/order claim under another key fails closed
Submit and cancel may use distinct canonical claims for the same order
Snapshot ordering and identities are deterministic
P20-E evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P20-E package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P20-A..P20-D remain canonical complete and P20-F remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Exact replay and conflict/duplicate guards enforced
Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
